flowtask-runner.description: Orchestrator of FlowTask workflow. Activates subagents, manages state via Engram. Only agent the user talks to directly.

flowtask-ca-writer.description: Guides requirement clarification through conversation. Helps user clarify what they need before formalizing CA. Never writes code or plans.

flowtask-planner.description: Analyzes requirements and generates implementation plans. Never writes code. Activated only through runner.

flowtask-constructor.description: Implements plans following project conventions retrieved from Engram. Never makes design decisions. Activated only through runner.

flowtask-validator.description: Validates implementation against plan and project conventions. Never writes code. Activated only through runner.

flowtask-initializer.description: Scans project and populates Engram with project context. Activated by the initialization flow and layer commands.

flowtask-logger.description: Instruments code with logging. Never modifies business logic. Activated by runner when logging is needed.

flowtask-tester.description: Generates tests for implemented code. Never modifies production code. Activated by runner when tests are needed.

flowtask-plan-auditor.description: Plan reviewer. Verifies plans are executable and references are valid. Auto-activates for plans with >5 tasks.

flowtask-review-orchestrator.description: Orquestador de revisión de código 4R Lenses. Recibe scope del runner, evalúa contexto, carga skills según criterios, reporta hallazgos con severidad. Read-only.

flowtask-inspector.description: Explore and validate any aspect of the project without creating a CA. Presents tradeoffs and GAPs.

flowtask-onboarder.description: Evaluates developer experience level through a technical quiz based on the project stack and assigns a runner personality.

flowtask-graphify-docs-media.description: Generates documentation and media for Graphify. Background agent activated after acceptance.

init-types.description: Scan and index only types/models layer into Engram
init-types.template:
Scan the types/models layer of this project:
1. Find all type definitions (models, interfaces, schemas, types)
2. Extract naming conventions and structure
3. Save to Engram with topic_key: project/types
$ARGUMENTS

init-data.template:

2. Extract query conventions and data patterns

$ARGUMENTS

$ARGUMENTS

onboard.description: Evaluate developer level and assign a runner personality
onboard.template:
Activate the onboarder to evaluate developer level and assign a personality.

1. Detect the command as COMMAND:/onboard.
2. Activate @flowtask-onboarder with the user's prompt.
3. After the onboarder completes, acknowledge the new personality if assigned.

$ARGUMENTS

update.description: Update FlowTask installation: sync agents, skills, plugins and config
update.template:
Update FlowTask installation in this project.
1. Sync agents from canonical source
2. Sync skills
3. Merge opencode.json
4. Reinstall plugins from manifest
5. Regenerate derived configs
$ARGUMENTS
